modify.note: Make every internal EventBusyDetails entry carry its source, while keeping the user-facing title separate from that diagnostic value. Add LimitSources helpers that return the translation key and descriptive source together, and pass that pair into LimitManager when it creates event-booking, event-duration, and team-limit busy intervals. Give buffer entries the same complete information. Preserve an external calendar's supplied source, and use the calendar fallback only when that source is absent.

Give date-override entries the same complete information. Apply `withSource` at the response boundary so callers that did not request diagnostic sources keep the expected response shape. Add `getUserAvailabilityIncludingBusyTimesFromLimits` as a wrapper around the existing `_getUserAvailability` method. Preserve `initialData.busyTimesFromLimitsBookings`, including an intentionally empty array, instead of overwriting it with a newly initialized empty list. Leave an absent value absent when no computation produced one, then forward the assembled initial data into the existing availability calculation.
Propagate busy-time metadata through interval subtraction with generic types so splitting a busy range does not discard its source.
Obtain the needed limit busy times through the existing busy-time services when they are not already supplied.
